title: Fix highlight scale and position
description:
Highlights drawn in the PDF Viewer (especially when zoomed in) were mirrored into Map Building using the wrong page size, so lines looked far off scale and out of place. Zooming far in the continuous PDF Viewer also broke overlay placement because normalized coords were computed against a native-size cap instead of the live display size.

This release treats normalized page fractions (nrx/nry) as the source of truth: viewer→map mirroring resolves those fractions first, continuous zoom re-syncs line and structure-node coords on every zoom/aspect change, and bake/export use the same resolved endpoints. New structure nodes store nrx/nry so Auto Highlights stay locked to the PDF content across zoom and workspace switches. Map lines are no longer tagged as viewer mirrors (fixes bake/dedupe).

Who is affected: PipeSync Plans / PDF Viewer / Map Building on pipeshare.live (BASE). SaaS unchanged until you apply the next platform release from cPanel.

If existing auto-highlights or bad map mirrors still look off, re-run Auto Highlights / re-draw those lines once after this update.
changeLog: Fix PDF Viewer zoom: highlights stay locked when zooming far in/out (nrx-based overlays).
Fix viewer→map highlight mirroring: live page size + normalized coords, not stale workspace dims.
Auto Highlights project onto Map when Map Building is active; structure nodes store nrx/nry.
Map lines are canonical (no mirroredFrom); bake/download use the same resolved endpoints.
